protocol.input: locateSight(name, cityName), two arguments only; all 98 entries including Beach
protocol.place_order: original curated list order within each city; nr is 1-based per city
protocol.cache: fresh worker process and empty in-memory localStorage for EVERY attempt; no cross-place anchors or cached results
protocol.city_centers: unmodified app cityCenter; uses built-in table for these five cities
protocol.retries: after each city, retry service_error places in list order in up to two cooldown rounds; retain LAST attempt; app retries/timeouts remain
protocol.final_status: service_error if any request has HTTP >=400, network/body-read error or lookup exception, even when coordinates were returned; otherwise found or not_found
protocol.classification: user-supplied thesis appendix; Pa artikull looked up but excluded from threshold checks
protocol.matched_service: final successful recorded response must contain returned coordinates; otherwise empty
protocol.duration: locateSight wall time, including app queues/retries; excludes response-clone drain and output
